name: 90745 · Carson, CA
findings: ZIP 90745 (Carson) has 157 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90745 (Carson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90745 (Carson) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.9 times the typical level).
